task: We want to add 20 charging points by 1 March 2027. Using the observed usage data, which existing sites/areas show the highest saturation and are the best candidates? Give a ranked shortlist with the data behind it.
markdown:
## Answer
BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 is the most saturated site, with occupancy of 66.9% and all points busy 46.2% of the time [E2]. BZ_BOEHLER_01 and the BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02 site next to it are the strongest follow-ups once evidence strength is considered [E2, E3]. The data cannot say how many of the 20 new points each site could absorb.

## Key findings
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01 (2 points) ranks 1 on occupancy at 66.9%, with full_time 46.2%, 203 observed_starts and coverage 0.147 [E2].
- BZ_P_VITTORIA (3 points) has occupancy of 63.5% but only 0.082 coverage and 110.55 h exposure, so it is less certain [E2].
- BZ_BOEHLER_01 (1 point) has occupancy and full_time of 57.0%, ranking 1 on full_time. This is partly because it has a single point. It also has the best coverage of the top 5 at 0.227, with 305.59 h exposure [E2, E3].
- BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02 has occupancy of 51.9% and the most observed_starts in the top 8 at 261, with coverage 0.167 [E2].
- BZ_PIAVE_01 has occupancy of 50.8%, 212 observed_starts and coverage 0.16. Its peak hour is 23:00 [E2].
- BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 (occupancy 56.1%, 53 starts, coverage 0.044) and BZ_RESSEL_01 (occupancy 52.2%, 46 starts, coverage 0.033) look saturated but rest on very little observed time [E2].
- Both RISPARMIO sites peak around local morning, with RISPARMIO_01 at 08:00 and RISPARMIO_02 at 09:00 [E2].

## Recommendation
Shortlist, ranked by saturation weighted by evidence strength:
1. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_01
2. BZ_BOEHLER_01
3. BZ_C_RISPARMIO_02
4. BZ_PIAVE_01
5. BZ_P_VITTORIA

The two RISPARMIO sites suggest a possible area cluster, which is an inference from the names and not a tested finding [E2]. Before committing, verify demand and grid or space capacity on site. Treat BZ_C_AUGUSTA_01 and BZ_RESSEL_01 as watch-list sites until better coverage exists.

## Limitations & unknowns
- Coverage is low everywhere, ranging from 0.044 to 0.227 among the top 5, so all figures rest on a small share of the 56-day window [E2, E4].
- Among five checked sites, gaps over 120 min range from 196 at BZ_BOEHLER_01 to 757 at BZ_P_VITTORIA. No gap data were retrieved for BZ_PIAVE_01 or BZ_RESSEL_01 [E4].
- Of the 51 sites, 43 have data in the window, and 22 were excluded for under 24 h of exposure, so some candidates may be missing [E1, E2].
- The top 8 are all small sites of 1 to 3 points [E2].
- Occupancy is not energy, official sessions, demand or faults [E1].
- Per-site capacity for the 20 new points is unavailable in the data.

## Sources
- [E1] dataset_overview — Open Data Hub EChargingPlug status (OCPI), window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E2] rank_sites(metric=occupancy) — Open Data Hub EChargingPlug status (OCPI), window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E3] rank_sites(metric=full_time) — Open Data Hub EChargingPlug status (OCPI), window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14
- [E4] data_quality — Open Data Hub EChargingPlug status (OCPI), window 2026-09-19..2026-11-14

review_note:
- **Main caveat:** Coverage is only 0.033–0.227 across the sites cited, so every occupancy figure (e.g., 66.9%, 46.2%) rests on a small slice of the 56-day window. Rankings could shift with more data, and occupancy is not demand or capacity.
- **Numbers:** All 44 checked numbers traced; none are untraced.
- **Gap:** The report gives no basis for splitting the 20 new points, and the RISPARMIO cluster is an inference from the site names.
